title: TSCR, AP-106, 222-S certification, and LAW transfer now have distinct feed-stage identities
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: The registry separates cesium-and-solids removal, AP-106 staging, laboratory certification, underground transfer, and LAW receipt; DOE's 1.1-million-gallon tank specification and waste-feed mission are attached only to AP-106's facility and mission records. Denominator: Five distinct feed preparation, quality, transfer, and receipt nodes plus one AP-106 feed-staging mission milestone.
